plays.desc_ko: 경기 시작 직후 GEN이 네 명을 바텀으로 보내 LYON의 부쉬 장악 시도를 노림. 결과는 해설에 언급되지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Right at the start, GEN sends four players bot to catch LYON trying to take control of the brush. The outcome isn't mentioned in the commentary.
plays.quote: Gen.G are sending four ... bottom immediately here expecting that ... contesting the brush control.

plays.quote: Isles trying to go all the way in ... BUT NOW IT'S ISLES TRAPPED ... FIRST BLOOD, GEN.G.

plays.desc_en: Canyon (Jarvan IV) ganks top and uses his E-Q combo to force out Dhokla's (Jayce) Flash, ending without a kill but leaving Dhokla flashless early.
plays.quote: getting ganked by Canyon ... least force the flash out of the lion ... top laner there with a quick EQ combo.
